summary: Frontend-only regression of the 'Remove Live + Videos-only-via-Profile/Discover + Fullscreen watch' iteration on WEB (React /app/frontend) and MOBILE (Expo /app/mobile) against shared FastAPI backend. All 12 web checks and all 6 mobile checks PASSED. No blocking or design bugs found. Two very minor code hygiene issues (duplicate testID + brace formatting) reported below.
action_items: (Minor) /app/mobile/app/settings.tsx — duplicate testID 'settings-privacy' on TWO rows: line 152 (Account > Privacy) and line 226 (Legal > Privacy Policy). Playwright/RTL will only match the first. Rename the Legal one to e.g. 'settings-legal-privacy'.

(Cosmetic) /app/mobile/app/video/upload.tsx:199 — closing brace `router.replace("/(tabs)/profile");    } catch (e: any) {` is on the same line as the catch. Not a bug, but a formatter run would fix it.

(Optional) /app/mobile/src/components/NotificationPermissionPrimer.tsx:140 still advertises 'Live streams from people you follow'. Now that Live is removed on both surfaces, this bullet is stale and should be removed or replaced.

(Optional) Legal copy in /app/mobile/app/legal/terms.tsx (section 6 'Live streaming') and /app/mobile/app/legal/privacy.tsx (mentions 'going Live') is now inaccurate. Consider updating to keep legal text truthful.
critical_code_review_comments: Web Shell (/app/frontend/src/App.js:32) uses regex `/^\/videos\/(?!new$)[^/]+$/` for the fullscreen route. Verified working with real video id, and /videos/new still renders inside AppShell. Good.
Web VideoWatch.jsx uses `if (window.history.length > 1) navigate(-1); else navigate('/discover')` for Back. Works well and matches the spec; on a cold direct load it correctly falls back to Discover.

Mobile app/video/upload.tsx post-publish navigates via `router.replace('/(tabs)/profile')` which is correct — replaces the upload screen in history so a system Back doesn't return the user into a stale upload form.

Backend rooms endpoints are intentionally still present (per request) but no UI surface reaches them. Recommend a follow-up task to gate/remove them server-side before public launch to shrink attack surface.
Rooms polling (Live.jsx) is no longer referenced — no dead polling on production build. Confirmed by absence of /app/frontend/src/pages/Live.jsx and no imports.

seed_data_creation: Published one video 'test_ web upload test_video_<ts>' via /videos/new (id 93ff3821-dad4-4528-8fb8-d7d49157b082). Prefixed test_ so it will be auto-purged on next backend restart.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://social-hub-dev-4.preview.emergentagent.com and Expo web preview https://social-hub-dev-4.expo.preview.emergentagent.com. WEB: sidebar renders exactly 5 items (nav-home, nav-blogs, nav-discover, nav-messages, nav-notifications) with no nav-videos / nav-live. /live and /videos both catch the '*' route in App.js and Navigate to '/'. Discover shows only 3 tabs (Top/Accounts/Tags), no discover-tab-live. /videos/new default visibility = Public (verified via SelectValue text). Publishing (title + hosted URL) redirects to /profile; the new video appears under Profile > Videos tab. Clicking a video from Profile opens /videos/:id which renders VideoWatch OUTSIDE AppShell (data-testid=video-fullscreen, no sidebar) and the back-btn (data-testid=video-back-btn) returns to /profile via navigate(-1). All main routes (/, /blogs, /discover, /messages, /notifications, /profile) load with no error boundaries. MOBILE: Expo bundles cleanly with NO import errors (verified: no red-screen, no PAGEERROR events, deleted files app/(tabs)/live.tsx, app/live/[id].tsx, src/lib/agora.ts, src/lib/agora.web.ts don't produce module-not-found). After founder login the app lands on /home and the floating pill bar shows exactly tab-home / tab-discover / tab-create / tab-profile — tab-live absent. Settings screen (data-testid queried) has NO settings-live row; settings-blogs row is present and functional in the Discover section. On desktop viewport (1440x900) DesktopSidebar HTML contains no '>Live<' text — Home/Discover/Messages/Blogs/Notifications/Profile items are the only nav destinations. Minor issue: duplicate testID 'settings-privacy' in settings.tsx (Account privacy row + Legal Privacy Policy row) — rename Legal one for testability.
rca of the issue: N/A — this was a feature/removal regression pass, no bugs surfaced.
